name: 33935 · Labelle, FL
findings: ZIP 33935 (Labelle) has 33 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 8 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33935 (Labelle) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33935 (Labelle) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 44% of the typical level).
